title: Prepaid Plus add-ons (synthetic)
text: Synthetic GCT Prepaid Plus customers can add the StreamMax add-on for 25 AED per month. Since October 2026 every streaming add-on also carries the 15 AED digital services fee, shown as a separate line on the bill.

title: Prepaid Plus add-ons (synthetic)
text: An add-on can be removed in the GCT app at any time. The digital services fee stops from the next billing cycle; charges already billed are not refunded pro rata.

title: Postpaid Max tariff (synthetic)
text: Synthetic GCT Postpaid Max costs 180 AED per month with 50 GB of data and unlimited local calls.

title: Enterprise roaming discount approval (synthetic)
text: Enterprise accounts with at least 25 active lines may request a roaming bundle discount. The request must name the bundle, the number of lines and the requested discount percentage.

title: Enterprise roaming discount approval (synthetic)
text: Account managers answer within 2 working days. Regional sales directors answer within 5 working days.

title: Enterprise pricing committee minutes (synthetic)
text: Draft committee minutes for the synthetic Q3 enterprise pricing review are restricted to the pricing committee.

title: Enterprise roaming bundle discount approval, 2025 edition (synthetic, retired)
text: Retired 2025 edition. Enterprise roaming bundle discounts for synthetic GCT accounts were approved by the regional sales manager alone, up to 40 percent, with no finance review.

title: Enterprise roaming bundle discount approval, 2027 draft (synthetic, not yet in force)
text: Draft for 2027. Enterprise roaming bundle discounts for synthetic GCT accounts will be approved by a pricing desk within one business day, up to 35 percent.

title: Enterprise roaming bundle discount approval, incident desk notes (synthetic)
text: Incident desk notes on enterprise roaming bundle discount approval for synthetic GCT accounts. Granted to the incident agent only, never to the knowledge portal.
